title: Cost Clarity Signet: Usage Mosaic & Compact Export Flow
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Design a compact, role-aware 'Usage Mosaic' panel and a lightweight export flow (CSV + JSONL) optimized for token-level cost analytics. The goal is to give engineers and finance teams a single-pane view to slice token spend by route, model variant, prompt slice, and user cohort, and to export curated slices for downstream chargeback systems.
acceptance_criteria: Mosaic panel surfaces top 10 contributors (route, model, user/group, prompt-tag) with percentage and absolute token spend
Per-row drilldown expands inline with sparkline, median latency, and example prompts (anonymized)
Export flow supports CSV and JSONL with selected columns, time-range, and aggregation window (min/median/95th)
Role-aware presets (Engineer, Finance, Ops) are available and customizable
Design passes stakeholder review and provides assets (Figma + annotated spec) for front-end handoff
comments: 2026-02-26 - Aisha Raman: Kickoff note. Working hypothesis: users need immediate 'what is costing me most right now' with fast export to billing systems. Proposed a compact grid (mosaic) prioritized by marginal token cost.
2026-03-02 - Marco Hsu: Wireframes v1 posted in Figma. Added inline drilldown and a small example-prompt preview. Asking Eng for feasibility on anonymized prompt snippets (privacy).
2026-03-04 - Priya Patel (PM): PM review — prefers explicit model-variant tagging in row header and ability to pin rows to dashboard. Also asked for 'alert if spend delta > 30% week-over-week'.

2026-03-05 - Security (Liam Ortega): Flagged PII risk on example prompts. Requested that any prompt previews be hashed/sampled and that export excludes raw prompt text unless flagged for legal/consent.

2026-03-07 - Marco Hsu: Updated prototype addressing prompt anonymization (shows tokenized fingerprint and anonymized blur). Added role presets: Engineer (latency + top tokens), Finance (spend + allocation), Ops (errors + SLO breaches).

2026-03-09 - Eng feedback (Sara Nguyen): Frontend can render compact mosaic but backend needs small API additions: aggregate_by route/model/user, include median latency and 95th token-rate in response. Filed ENG-19921 to track API work.

2026-03-11 - Aisha Raman: Design critique session notes. Decision: Default sort = marginal cost contribution; add lightweight filter chips (time window, model family, route tag). Action: finalize export column list and CSV sample.
2026-03-12 - Marco Hsu: Prepared final handoff doc and acceptance checklist. Waiting on ENG-19921 and ENG-19945 (export-job endpoints) before component dev spike.
